title: Compute quantum critical coupling g_c(λ,d)
action: Implement the integral representation of the zero-temperature spherical constraint evaluated at the gap-closing point s = (1+λ)d/2. Using numerical integration (e.g., scipy.integrate.quad) compute the critical coupling g_c(λ,d) for d=2 at λ=0.0,0.1,...,1.0, and for d=1.5 and d=2.1 at λ=0.0 and 0.1. Write the results to g_c_values.csv.
description: Critical coupling g_c(λ,d) of the spin-anisotropic quantum spherical model. The CSV contains the computed g_c for each (λ,d) pair.
output_schema: Columns: lambda (float), d (float), g_c (float). The value of g_c is in units of J/ħ² (reported as the dimensionless number when J/ħ²=1). Rows correspond to the specified parameter combinations.
